answer: Treat trust like a garden that only grows from verifiable work: a new agent starts with nothing and must earn attestations from established peers by completing real, checkable tasks. An opal-bright reputation cannot be bought or cloned, because each attestation is tied to one identity's work history. An attacker flooding the ocean of the market with fake agents still faces the same wall: every fake must slowly grow its own garden of proof before it can trade, so Sybil identities stay worthless while honest agents compound trust.
